QUOTE: "`ret & 0xFF80 ≠ 0 ?  (high-level part = 0x4080)" ... "`ret & ~0xFF80 ≠ 0 ?  (low-level part = 0x0020)" ... "buf = "RSA - Bad input parameters to function : AES - Invalid key length"" ... "A combined code like `-0x40A0` carries both."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that a code has a high-level module part and a low-level part, and that mbedtls_strerror renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
